title: Interviews with Huawei CEO Ren Zhengfei and others on how Trump's restrictions pushed Huawei toward self-reliance, making it central to China's AI ambitions (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: Interviews with Huawei CEO Ren Zhengfei and others on how Trump's restrictions pushed Huawei toward self-reliance, making it central to China's AI ambitions — As China's access to Nvidia's advanced chips shrinks, Huawei is becoming increasingly indispensable to Beijing despite a wide technological gap with its American rival.
